scores.decision_correct_quote: biggest gap is that no flow on the page is agent-initiated — there is no example of an agent capturing and reading a page, only humans uploading to agents.

must_catch.quote: every flow on the page is human-initiated — "You → Agent" — so a visitor whose goal is "my agent captures and reads web pages itself" finds no agent-side invocation anywhere on the page.
exclusively a Claude Code one — the landing route names Claude Code six times and names no other agent CLI, so a Codex/Grok arrival sees no proof it applies to them.

The page makes a "No account needed" promise directly under an upload form whose URL path refuses anonymous users, which is a hard contradiction for a zero-click trial funnel. [...] The install command is the page's key conversion asset but is gated behind account creation, so the landing page currently has no zero-click entry point at all. EVIDENCE: Pack: "Create an account to get your API key.50 uploads/day, OCR, Al analysis, and full MCP integration-no credit card needed."
A blocking cookie modal is interposed over the hero and upload form on first paint in both viewports
The only terminal block on the page is the connect command ("claude mcp add whipnode …"); the pack contains no example of an agent calling a tool and no sample output URL/format.

false_objections.quote: On mobile the install command renders truncated rather than wrapped, so the page's one copy-paste payload is unusable
false_objections.why: OCR fragments do not establish mobile wrapping behavior or copy-paste usability

scores.notes: The memo partially matches the launch decision but prioritizes different fixes, misses the explicit on-page free-tier visibility issue, and labels only unrelated footer garble NO-SIGNAL.
